abstract: This paper investigates the impact of creativity on technological advancement, long‐term economic development, and social welfare, where creativity is determined endogenously through interactions within social networks. The analysis shows that an economy remains stagnant, exhibiting neither networking nor long‐term growth, when the size of the creative class falls below a positive threshold. Once this threshold is exceeded, active networking between creative and non‐creative individuals emerges, fostering sustained technological progress and income growth. The model is calibrated and used to simulate the transition from stagnation to sustained growth. The results indicate meaningful welfare gains from such a transition, driven by the cumulative effects of technological progress facilitated by networking.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了创造力对技术进步、长期经济发展及社会福利的影响，其中创造力通过社会网络内部的互动内生决定。分析表明，当创意阶层规模低于某个正阈值时，经济将陷入停滞，既无网络互动也无长期增长。一旦超过该阈值，创意与非创意个体之间将形成活跃的网络互动，从而推动持续的技术进步与收入增长。本文对模型进行了校准，并用于模拟从停滞到持续增长的转型过程。结果表明，这种转型能带来显著的福利提升，其驱动力源于网络互动所促进的技术进步的累积效应。
title: Creative‐class dynamics, technological evolution and growth
title_zh: 创意阶层动态、技术演进与增长

abstract: We study how expatriates cope when conflict breaks out in their homeland. Using Russia’s 2022 invasion of Ukraine as a natural experiment, we identify causal effects using a matched difference-in-differences design, comparing incumbent Ukrainian migrants in Sweden to matched migrants from other countries. We show that Ukrainian expatriates experience immediate and persistent mental health deterioration—a 30 percent increase in psychiatric prescription use that remains elevated three years later—while simultaneously increasing employment and earnings. A simple framework rationalizes this pattern through two channels operating in opposite directions: concern for family safety worsens mental health and raises the disutility of work, while heightened financial responsibilities raise the return to earning income. Consistent with reduced reservation wages, Ukrainians take on secondary jobs, exit unemployment faster into lower-quality jobs, and earn less than comparable coworkers. Earnings effects concentrate among migrants from more war-exposed regions, while mental health effects attenuate in Swedish municipalities with more Ukrainian refugee arrivals. Results replicate in European and US survey data. As global migration and armed conflict both reach historic highs, the findings show that the welfare costs of war extend across borders, shaping the well-being and economic behavior of expatriates worldwide.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了外籍人士在祖国爆发冲突时的应对机制。以2022年俄罗斯入侵乌克兰作为自然实验，采用匹配双重差分法，将瑞典境内的乌克兰移民与来自其他国家的匹配移民进行对比，识别出因果效应。研究表明，乌克兰外籍人士的心理健康立即且持续恶化——精神类药物处方量增加30%，三年后仍维持高位——同时其就业率和收入同步上升。一个简单框架通过两个反向作用渠道解释了这一模式：对家人安全的担忧加剧心理健康问题并提高工作负效用，而经济责任加重则提升了收入回报。与保留工资下降一致，乌克兰移民从事副业、更快脱离失业状态但进入低质量岗位，且收入低于可比同事。来自战争更激烈地区的移民收入效应更为显著，而乌克兰难民接收量较多的瑞典市镇中，心理健康效应有所减弱。该结果在欧洲及美国调查数据中均得到验证。在全球移民与武装冲突均达历史高位的背景下，研究显示战争福利成本跨越国界，深刻影响着全球外籍人士的福祉与经济行为。
title: Beyond the Battlefield: The Impact of War on Expatriates’ Health and Livelihoods
title_zh: 超越战场：战争对外籍人士健康与生计的影响

abstract: This paper studies unit root testing based on least absolute deviations (LAD) regression under unconditional heteroscedasticity. We first derive asymptotic properties of the LAD estimator under both unit root and local-to-unity settings in the presence of unconditional heteroscedasticity and weak dependence. The results show that the limiting distribution of the LAD estimator (and thus the derived test statistics) is closely associated with unknown heteroscedasticity. To conduct feasible LAD-based unit root tests, we propose a novel adaptive block bootstrap procedure, which accommodates unconditional heteroscedasticity and serial dependence, both of which exhibit unknown forms, to compute critical values. The asymptotic validity of the proposed bootstrap method is established. Furthermore, we extend the testing procedure to incorporate deterministic components, such as a constant term or a linear trend. Simulation results show that, in the presence of unconditional heteroscedasticity and serial dependence, the proposed tests exhibit reasonable size control, whereas the classic LAD/quantile-based tests developed under homoscedasticity exhibit severe size distortion. Additionally, compared to existing least squares based tests, our new tests show superior testing power when the data are heavy-tailed. Finally, empirical analysis based on unemployment rates is conducted to illustrate the applicability of the new tests.
title: Adaptive LAD-Based Bootstrap Unit Root Tests Under Unconditional Heteroscedasticity
title_zh: 基于自适应LAD的自回归单位根检验在无条件异方差下的应用

abstract: This paper estimates the direct and intergenerational effects of one of the world’s largest school expansion policies. Starting in 1993-94, the District Primary Education Programme (DPEP) constructed over 100,000 new schools and served over 50 million children in India. Using a fuzzy regression discontinuity design I show that the policy increased enrollment, literacy and years of education for both male and female direct beneficiaries. Further, I find that children whose mothers were DPEP beneficiaries had higher scores on vernacular (18 percent), math (13 percent), and English (15 percent) tests, while Father’s DPEP exposure had no effect on children’s learning.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了全球规模最大的学校扩张政策之一的直接效应与代际效应。自1993-94年起，地区初等教育计划（DPEP）在印度新建了超过10万所学校，惠及逾5000万儿童。利用模糊断点回归设计，我发现该政策提高了直接受益男性和女性的入学率、识字率及受教育年限。此外，研究显示，母亲为DPEP受益者的儿童在方言（18%）、数学（13%）和英语（15%）测试中得分更高，而父亲接触DPEP对儿童学习无显著影响。
title: School Construction and Intergenerational Human Capital
title_zh: 学校建设与代际人力资本

abstract: In the wake of the 2018–19 U.S.-China tariff hikes, there has been a significant shift in U.S. supply chains, with Mexico emerging as the largest supplier of U.S. imports, surpassing China. This shift has been attributed in part to Mexico gaining a cost advantage over China following the U.S tariffs on China.

abstract: We use the near-universe of Chinese online job ads (2016–2023; 3.2M postings) to measure job-level skill demand and city-specific skill premia. Combining keyword dictionaries with a Chinese BERT classifier, we construct standardized intensities for skills. Three facts emerge. (i) Skill requirements vary sharply across metropolitan areas (MAs), especially for IT. (ii) Prices do not always track skill intensities: high skill demand does not imply high skill premium. (iii) IT and interpersonal premia polarize across MAs and also polarize within jobs. Results offer policy-relevant descriptive implications for worker location and firm siting.
abstract_zh: 我们利用近乎全量的中国在线招聘广告数据（2016-2023年；320万条帖子）来衡量岗位层面的技能需求及城市特定的技能溢价。结合关键词词典与中文BERT分类器，我们构建了标准化的技能强度指标。研究揭示三个事实：（一）技能需求在都市圈间差异显著，尤其在信息技术领域；（二）价格并不总是与技能强度同步：高技能需求并不意味着高技能溢价；（三）信息技术与人际交往技能溢价在都市圈间呈现极化现象，且在岗位内部也存在极化。研究结果为劳动者选址与企业布局提供了具有政策参考价值的描述性启示。

abstract: This study uses national survey data from the Chinese Household Income Project for 2002, 2013, and 2023 to examine the influence of task-based factors on the gender wage gap (GWG) in urban China in 2002–2023. We construct multi-period indicators of non-routine task intensity and employ decomposition methods to explore two channels through which tasks influence the GWG. The results indicate that the wage premium for non-routine tasks was higher for women than for men during the period 2002–2023, and several robustness checks support this conclusion. The gender differences in the non-routine task wage premium vary by age and education group, and across the wage distribution. The decomposition results suggest that gender disparities in wage premiums for non-routine tasks (the price effect) contributed to narrowing the GWG in all three sample periods, although the magnitude of this effect declined from 2002 to 2023. By contrast, gender differences in the allocation of non-routine tasks (the endowment effect) widened the GWG in 2002 and 2023, while narrowed it in 2013. Additionally, both the endowment and price effects on the GWG differ across wage distributions in each period.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用中国家庭收入调查2002年、2013年及2023年的全国性数据，考察了基于任务的因素对2002至2023年间中国城镇性别工资差距的影响。我们构建了非例行任务强度的多时期指标，并采用分解方法探索任务影响性别工资差距的两条途径。结果显示，在2002至2023年期间，女性在非例行任务上的工资溢价高于男性，且多项稳健性检验支持这一结论。非例行任务工资溢价的性别差异在不同年龄、教育群体及工资分布上表现各异。分解结果表明，非例行任务工资溢价的性别差异（价格效应）在三个样本期内均有助于缩小性别工资差距，尽管该效应从2002年到2023年有所减弱。相比之下，非例行任务分配上的性别差异（禀赋效应）在2002年和2023年扩大了性别工资差距，而在2013年则缩小了该差距。此外，各时期工资分布上的禀赋效应和价格效应对性别工资差距的影响亦存在差异。

abstract: We study the internationalization of the Chinese renminbi (RMB) leveraging a unique policy experiment. In 2023, amid a dollar shortage, Argentina expanded a currency swap line with China. The share of imports from China invoiced in RMB surged rapidly, displacing the dollar, which had previously accounted for virtually all invoicing. Following the presidential election of late 2023, as the dollar shortage eased, invoicing in RMB declined. We explore the mechanisms behind this pattern, using firm-level data on imports, bank-firm loan relationships, and bank balance sheets. We find that banks played a key role. Firms with pre-existing relationships to banks with limited US dollar loans were more likely to switch to RMB. In addition, firms borrowing from a Chinese state-owned bank were more likely to use RMB. We also document firm-level spillovers, with RMB use for imports from China increasing RMB use for imports from other countries. Finally, firms switching to RMB saw increased total imports.
abstract_zh: 我们利用一项独特的政策实验来研究人民币的国际使用。2023年，在美元短缺的背景下，阿根廷扩大了与中国的货币互换额度。从中国进口的商品以人民币计价的比例迅速上升，取代了此前几乎占据全部计价份额的美元。随着2023年末总统大选后美元短缺状况缓解，人民币计价比例有所下降。我们利用企业层面的进口数据、银行与企业间的贷款关系以及银行资产负债表，探讨了这一现象背后的机制。研究发现，银行在其中发挥了关键作用。与美元贷款有限的银行有既有关系的企业更倾向于转向使用人民币。此外，从中国国有银行借款的企业也更可能使用人民币。我们还记录了企业层面的溢出效应，即从中国进口时使用人民币会增加从其他国家进口时使用人民币的可能性。最后，转向使用人民币的企业总进口额有所增加。

abstract: With the increasing risk of global food insecurity, countries have accelerated their efforts to reduce food loss and waste. Moreover, traditional agricultural policies, such as income subsidies, significantly impact farmers' behaviour and grain production and likely food losses. Based on survey data from 1885 maize growers in China, we measured maize harvest losses in China and empirically analysed the impact of income subsidies on such losses. The results showed that on average, 3.02% of the total maize amount was lost at the harvest stage, and the loss per unit area was 17.5 kg/mu (262.5 kg/ha). Income subsidies were significantly correlated with greater maize harvest losses, and this conclusion remained robust after potential endogeneity problems were resolved. A heterogeneity analysis revealed that the impact of income subsidies on maize harvest losses was significant for small‐scale farmers but not for large‐scale farmers. We suggest that the Chinese government should accelerate the transformation of agri‐food systems and the reform of income subsidy policies, which should encourage farmers to increase the scale of their operations, and these subsidies should be transformed into more targeted policies to meet the requirements for reducing food losses.
abstract_zh: 随着全球粮食不安全风险的加剧，各国纷纷加快减少粮食损失与浪费的步伐。此外，传统农业政策（如收入补贴）显著影响农户行为及粮食生产，并可能加剧粮食损失。基于中国1885户玉米种植户的调查数据，我们测算了中国玉米收获环节的损失，并实证分析了收入补贴对这类损失的影响。结果表明，玉米在收获阶段的平均损失占总产量的3.02%，单位面积损失为17.5公斤/亩（262.5公斤/公顷）。收入补贴与玉米收获损失显著正相关，且在解决潜在内生性问题后，这一结论依然稳健。异质性分析显示，收入补贴对玉米收获损失的影响在小规模农户中显著，但对大规模农户不显著。我们建议中国政府加速农业食品体系转型及收入补贴政策改革，鼓励农户扩大经营规模，并将补贴转化为更具针对性的政策，以满足减少粮食损失的要求。

abstract: This study analyses the records in the Cairo geniza , the distribution of Chinese ceramics, the reports of travellers (this is the best‐known, but least important, dataset), and the discussions of the Portuguese regarding how best to exploit pepper in the sixteenth and early seventeenth centuries. This is then set against what evidence there is from Kerala itself. It emerges that, despite the importance of pepper to the trading systems of the medieval period, the impact of that trade on Kerala was of relatively small importance. The Kerala economy was based on rice, and it remained so. The article therefore contributes to the growing historiography which stresses internal regional economies rather than external trading as the best guide for understanding pre‐modern development, as opposed to world‐systems theories, but it also aims to show in detail why it was that the pepper trade had relatively little impact on its producer region. Kerala was the only source of pepper for the whole Eurasian world until the late Middle Ages. This article argues that, despite the importance of pepper to the trading systems of the medieval period, the impact of that trade on Kerala was of relatively small importance, and discusses why.
abstract_zh: 本研究分析了开罗藏经库文献、中国陶瓷分布、旅行者报告（这是最知名但重要性最低的数据集），以及16至17世纪早期葡萄牙人关于如何最佳利用胡椒的讨论。随后将这些证据与喀拉拉邦本地的史料进行对照。研究发现，尽管胡椒在中世纪贸易体系中具有重要地位，但该贸易对喀拉拉邦的影响相对较小。喀拉拉邦的经济以稻米为基础，且始终如此。因此，本文为强调以区域内部经济而非外部贸易作为理解前现代发展最佳路径的史学新范式提供了佐证——这与世界体系理论形成对比；同时旨在详细阐释为何胡椒贸易对其产地影响甚微。喀拉拉邦直至中世纪末期仍是整个欧亚大陆唯一的胡椒产地。本文论证指出，尽管胡椒在中世纪贸易体系中举足轻重，但该贸易对喀拉拉邦的影响相对有限，并探讨了其成因。

abstract: In many environmental problems, emissions are hard to monitor and abatement costs are privately known. We study how efficient abatement nevertheless can be induced through market‐like arrangements that condition transfers on verifiable abatement rather than on measured emissions. We characterize the transfer schemes that implement efficient abatement in unique dominant strategies and show that a single scheme, the beneficiaries‐compensate transfer scheme, emerges under two distinct characterizations: one based on equilibrium properties and one grounded in classical fairness axioms. Under the beneficiaries‐compensate transfer scheme, each agent compensates others according to the benefits received from their abatement. We illustrate its usefulness in two applications.
abstract_zh: 在许多环境问题中，排放难以监测且减排成本属于私人信息。我们研究如何通过类似市场的安排——即依据可验证的减排量而非实测排放量进行转移支付——仍能实现有效减排。我们刻画了在唯一占优策略下实现有效减排的转移方案，并表明一种单一方案——受益者补偿转移方案——可通过两种不同特征化方式得出：一种基于均衡性质，另一种基于经典公平性公理。在受益者补偿转移方案下，每个参与者根据从他人减排中获得的收益对他人进行补偿。我们通过两个应用案例说明其有效性。
title: Shifting the reference point in environmental regulation: from polluter‐pays to beneficiaries‐compensate
title_zh: 环境规制中的参照点转移：从污染者付费到受益者补偿

abstract: Public pension and public health care policies – collectively referred to here as social security policies – are costly and increasingly challenged by demographic shifts. Using a two‐period overlapping generations model in which health investment affects both mortality and morbidity, we analytically study the optimal design of social security. Our model incorporates three market imperfections: an intergenerational externality, a constraint on saving for future consumption, and incomplete insurance markets. It also considers three policy instruments: subsidies for health investment, subsidies for health expenditures, and a pay‐as‐you‐go pension replacement rate. We analyze how the imperfections, along with evolving trends in mortality and morbidity, shape the optimal set‐up of social security policies. Our findings show that there is no universal design for optimal social security: the effectiveness of each instrument depends on the others and on market conditions, with stronger prevention policies emerging as key in aging societies and in systems with less generous pensions.
abstract_zh: 公共养老金与公共医疗政策——统称为社会保障政策——成本高昂，且日益受到人口结构变化的挑战。本文采用一个两期世代交叠模型（其中健康投资同时影响死亡率和发病率），从理论层面分析社会保障的最优设计。模型纳入三种市场不完善因素：代际外部性、未来消费储蓄约束以及不完全保险市场；同时考虑三种政策工具：健康投资补贴、医疗支出补贴以及现收现付制养老金替代率。我们分析了这些市场不完善因素如何与死亡率和发病率的演变趋势共同塑造社会保障政策的最优配置。研究结果表明，最优社会保障并不存在统一模式：每种工具的有效性取决于其他工具及市场条件，在老龄化社会及养老金待遇较低的制度中，强化预防性政策成为关键举措。
title: On the optimality of social security instruments
title_zh: 论社会保障工具的最优性

abstract: This paper examines how a natural disaster, the Dust Bowl, shapes occupational choices in farm households across generations. Using full‐count US census data, I find that young adult sons shift away from self‐employed farming toward wage farm work and nonagricultural sectors after the Dust Bowl. Younger children with affected farming parents are more likely to leave agriculture and earn higher income. Migration and schooling serve as mechanisms, and New Deal relief spending mitigates the Dust Bowl's effects. Overall, the Dust Bowl accelerated occupational reallocation among younger children of farmers and contributed to US mid‐20th century structural change.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了自然灾害“沙尘暴”如何跨代塑造农户家庭的职业选择。利用美国人口普查全量数据，我发现沙尘暴后，年轻成年儿子从自营农业转向雇佣农业劳动和非农部门。受影响的农民家庭中，年幼子女更可能离开农业并获得更高收入。迁移与教育是作用机制，而新政救济支出缓解了沙尘暴的影响。总体而言，沙尘暴加速了农民年轻子女的职业再配置，并推动了美国20世纪中期的结构性变革。
title: Natural disaster and intergenerational occupational choice in agriculture: Evidence from the US Dust Bowl
title_zh: 自然灾害与农业代际职业选择：来自美国沙尘暴的证据

abstract: Large-scale land use changes can lead to a fundamental reorganisation of the land and corresponding socioecological regime. These regime shifts are notably hard to detect, predict or model, often arising from unprecedented changes in technology, markets or policies. In a remote rural region in Portugal, we tracked the land use history in three parishes between 1899 and 2018, capturing multiple disruptive socioeconomic and political circumstances, to assess whether a regime shift was triggered. We used a causal historical approach that included the spatio-temporal mapping of LULC changes and a socioecological event timeline to track policy changes and other important events or circumstances. We used these, and other available (historic) literature, to contextualise local information provided in oral history interviews (OHI) that revealed land managers’ decision-making during the last 70 years. We found that during the Estado Novo dictatorship, productivism-based policies had a strong influence on the observed land use intensification, yet OHI revealed that the high level of self-sufficiency agriculture made alternative trajectories unlikely if not impossible. After the 1974 revolution, recalibration took place in the form of a rural exodus and associated land reorganisation, including tenure and production systems. Overall, semi-natural areas, which usually depend on grazing or pastoralism, strongly diminished, while natural and plantation forests expanded. Arable land areas remained relatively stable across the entire study period. Our study shows that land systems that have undergone disruptive changes in the past may continue to evolve discontinuously afterwards, without causing a socioecological regime shift or breaking path dependence.
abstract_zh: 大规模土地利用变化可能导致土地及其相应的社会生态体系发生根本性重组。这些体系转变往往难以察觉、预测或建模，通常源于技术、市场或政策的空前变化。在葡萄牙一个偏远的乡村地区，我们追踪了1899年至2018年间三个教区的土地利用历史，捕捉了多次破坏性的社会经济和政治环境，以评估是否触发了体系转变。我们采用了一种因果历史方法，包括土地利用/土地覆盖变化的时空制图和社会生态事件时间线，以追踪政策变化及其他重要事件或情况。我们利用这些资料及其他可用的（历史）文献，对口头历史访谈中提供的本地信息进行背景化处理，这些访谈揭示了土地管理者在过去70年间的决策过程。我们发现，在“新国家”独裁时期，基于生产主义的政策对观察到的土地利用集约化产生了强烈影响，但口头历史访谈显示，高度自给自足的农业使得替代路径即使不是不可能，也是极不可能实现的。1974年革命后，以农村人口外流及相应的土地重组（包括土地所有权和生产体系）形式进行了重新调整。总体而言，通常依赖放牧或畜牧业的半自然区域大幅减少，而自然林和人工林则有所扩展。在整个研究期间，耕地面积保持相对稳定。我们的研究表明，过去经历过破坏性变化的土地系统可能在此后继续以不连续的方式演变，而不会引发社会生态体系转变或打破路径依赖。
title: Similar patterns, different processes: Persistence and change in path-dependent land systems
title_zh: 相似模式，不同过程：路径依赖土地系统中的持续与变迁

abstract: Remotely sensed measurements and other machine learning predictions are increasingly used in place of direct observations in empirical analyses. Errors in such measures may bias parameter estimation, but it remains unclear how large such biases are or how to correct for them. We leverage a new benchmark dataset providing co-located ground truth observations and remotely sensed measurements for multiple variables across the contiguous U.S. to show that the common practice of using remotely sensed measurements without correction leads to biased parameter point estimates and standard errors across a diversity of empirical settings. More than three-quarters of the 95% confidence intervals we estimate using remotely sensed measurements do not contain the true coefficient of interest. These biases result from both classical measurement error and more structured measurement error, which we find is common in machine learning based remotely sensed measurements. We show that multiple imputation, a standard statistical imputation technique so far untested in this setting, effectively reduces bias and improves statistical coverage with only minor reductions in power in both simple linear regression and panel fixed effects frameworks. Our results demonstrate that multiple imputation is a generalizable and easily implementable method for correcting parameter estimates relying on remotely sensed variables.
abstract_zh: 遥感测量及其他机器学习预测在实证分析中日益取代直接观测数据。此类测量中的误差可能导致参数估计偏误，但此类偏误的严重程度及修正方法尚不明确。我们利用一项新的基准数据集，该数据集提供了美国本土多个变量的共址地面实况观测与遥感测量数据，以证明在多种实证情境下，未经修正直接使用遥感测量的常见做法会导致参数点估计及标准误出现偏误。我们使用遥感测量数据估计的95%置信区间中，超过四分之三未包含真实的关注系数。这些偏误既源于经典测量误差，也源于更具结构性的测量误差，而后者在基于机器学习的遥感测量中普遍存在。我们证明，多重插补——一种在此情境下尚未得到检验的标准统计插补技术——能有效减少偏误并提升统计覆盖率，且在简单线性回归及面板固定效应框架中仅带来轻微的功效损失。我们的研究结果表明，多重插补是一种可推广且易于实施的方法，适用于修正依赖遥感变量的参数估计。
journal: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
title: Parameter recovery using remotely sensed variables
title_zh: 使用遥感变量进行参数反演

abstract: We measure benefits to households from Mumbai’s new Metro rail system. We estimate a commute mode choice model to value commute time savings in the short run and a housing choice model to value the improved commuting utility that households experience due to spatial sorting. Aggregate benefits from the Metro rail are over 10 times higher when spatial sorting occurs. In the short run women, college-educated workers, and workers with above median incomes experience higher benefits than their opposites. In the long run, households with lower incomes and assets and less than college education benefit more than their wealthier counterparts.
abstract_zh: 我们衡量了孟买新地铁系统为家庭带来的效益。我们估计了一个通勤方式选择模型，以评估短期内的通勤时间节省价值，以及一个住房选择模型，以评估家庭因空间分选而体验到的通勤效用改善。当发生空间分选时，地铁带来的总效益超过其十倍以上。短期内，女性、受过大学教育的工人以及收入高于中位数的工人所获得的效益高于其对应群体。长期来看，收入较低、资产较少且教育水平低于大学的家庭比更富裕的家庭受益更多。
title: The benefits of public transit to households: Evidence from India
title_zh: 公共交通对家庭的好处：来自印度的证据

abstract: Using Chinese A-share listed firms from 2007 to 2022, this paper examines how supply chain risk perception affects cross-regional investment. We find that such perception significantly reduces cross-regional investment, while regional FinTech development mitigates this effect. Mechanism tests identify three channels: increased cash holdings, weakened risk-taking willingness, and strategic contraction. The inhibitory effect is more pronounced in firms within highly competitive industries, regions with lower internet development, and firms with severe managerial myopia. Our findings illuminate the spatial spillover effects of supply chain risk and offer evidence for optimizing cross-regional investment decisions.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2007年至2022年中国A股上市公司数据，考察供应链风险感知对跨区域投资的影响。研究发现，供应链风险感知显著减少了企业的跨区域投资，而区域金融科技的发展则缓解了这一效应。机制检验识别出三条路径：现金持有增加、风险承担意愿减弱及战略收缩。抑制作用在竞争激烈行业中的企业、互联网发展水平较低地区以及管理层短视严重的企业中更为显著。本研究揭示了供应链风险的空间溢出效应，并为优化跨区域投资决策提供了证据支持。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Supply chain risk perception, FinTech, and cross-regional capital flows: evidence from China
title_zh: 供应链风险感知、金融科技与跨区域资本流动：来自中国的证据

title: Slum Housing Externalities
title_zh: 贫民窟住房的外部性

abstract: We study the interplay between a “one person-one vote” political system and a “one share-one vote” corporate governance regime. If shareholders push firms for more prosocial policies, political backlash may arise, undoing these initiatives. If public policy is frictionless, shareholder democracy becomes irrelevant: the political system fully offsets shareholder influence. With public policy frictions, prosocial corporations can mitigate regulatory shortcomings and enhance corporate public goods provision. Nevertheless, shareholder democracy can hurt citizens due to the representation problem: it favors the preferences of the wealthy. Investor diversification, pass-through voting, and corporate greenwashing have important implications for these trade-offs of shareholder democracy. (JEL D62, D72, G28, G34, G38, H23)
abstract_zh: 我们研究“一人一票”政治体制与“一股一票”公司治理制度之间的相互作用。如果股东推动企业采取更多亲社会政策，可能引发政治反弹，从而抵消这些举措。若公共政策无摩擦，股东民主便失去意义：政治体制将完全抵消股东的影响力。在存在公共政策摩擦的情况下，亲社会企业能够弥补监管缺陷，提升企业公共品供给。然而，由于代表性问题，股东民主可能损害公民利益：它更偏向富裕阶层的偏好。投资者多元化、传递投票以及企业漂绿行为对股东民主的这些权衡具有重要影响。（JEL D62, D72, G28, G34, G38, H23）
title: Voting on Public Goods: Citizens vs Shareholders
title_zh: 公共产品投票：公民与股东

abstract: The long, physically demanding hours that physicians, particularly surgeons, work during their training could impact physician mothers’ birth outcomes. Using Texas birth data from 2007 to 2014, we compare birth outcomes between physicians and lawyers and between surgeons and non-surgeon physicians. We then examine whether the 2011 duty hour reform, which lowered trainee work hours, impacted those birth outcomes. We find that physicians have an increased incidence of having low birth weight and small for gestational age infants, with the results driven by surgeons. In addition, we find that the duty hour reform is associated with a reduction in the incidence of small for gestational age infants for younger physicians.
abstract_zh: 医生，尤其是外科医生，在培训期间长时间、高强度的体力工作，可能影响医生母亲的生育结果。利用2007年至2014年得克萨斯州的出生数据，我们比较了医生与律师、外科医生与非外科医生之间的生育结果。随后，我们考察了2011年值班时间改革（该改革降低了实习医生的工作时长）是否对这些生育结果产生影响。我们发现，医生生育低出生体重儿和小于胎龄儿的概率增加，这一结果主要由外科医生驱动。此外，我们还发现，值班时间改革与年轻医生生育小于胎龄儿概率的降低相关。
title: Occupational Hazard? An analysis of birth outcomes among physician mothers
title_zh: 职业危害？医生母亲生育结果分析

abstract: We provide quasi-experimental evidence on the labor market returns to industry-recognized credentials connected to community college noncredit workforce training programs. Using novel individual-level administrative data on noncredit workforce training program enrollees in the Virginia Community College System and individual fixed effects models, we estimate the returns to industry credentials by comparing the labor market trajectories of credential earners and individuals who complete the same training but do not obtain a credential. Our results indicate that earning an industry credential increases quarterly earnings by approximately $818, which is partially attributable to a higher likelihood of transitioning into a higher-paying industry. We estimate these earnings gains would exceed program costs in just over half a year.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了关于与社区学院非学分劳动力培训项目相关联的行业认可证书在劳动力市场回报方面的准实验证据。利用弗吉尼亚社区学院系统中非学分劳动力培训项目参与者的新颖个体层面行政数据，并采用个体固定效应模型，我们通过比较获得证书者与完成相同培训但未获得证书者的劳动力市场轨迹，来估计行业证书的回报。我们的结果表明，获得行业证书可使季度收入增加约818美元，这部分归因于转向更高薪酬行业的可能性增大。我们估计，这些收入增长将在半年多一点的时间内超过项目成本。
title: Noncredit workforce training, industry credentials, and labor market outcomes
title_zh: 非信贷劳动力培训、行业证书与劳动力市场结果

abstract: This paper develops a dynamic equilibrium model of crime with heterogeneous agents and human capital accumulation. Agents decide whether to commit crimes by comparing potential gains with the expected punishment. Public security policies are defined as pairs of a size of the police force and an average sentence length. We propose a micro-founded public security technology linking expenditures on police to the probability of apprehension of a criminal. We illustrate the relevance of this theoretical framework by using an estimated version of the model using US data to (i) characterize the socially optimal public security policy; (ii) explore potential complementarities across public security and educational policies; and (iii) show that comparative statics exercises often lead, under reasonable parameter values, to recommendations that differ from those obtained in a global optimality analysis. These results highlight the relevance of equilibrium considerations in the economic analysis of crime. The paper gives a methodological first step towards building a manageable model of crime that can bring together different pieces of evidence—and equilibrium considerations—when evaluating the trade-offs across policy alternatives.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个包含异质性主体与人力资本积累的动态均衡犯罪模型。行为人通过比较潜在收益与预期惩罚来决定是否实施犯罪。公共安全政策被定义为警力规模与平均刑期长度的组合。我们提出了一种基于微观基础的公共安全技术，将警务支出与罪犯被捕概率相关联。通过使用美国数据对模型进行参数估计，我们阐明了该理论框架的适用性，具体用于：（i）刻画社会最优公共安全政策；（ii）探索公共安全政策与教育政策之间的潜在互补性；（iii）证明在合理参数取值下，比较静态分析得出的政策建议往往与全局最优性分析结果存在差异。这些结论凸显了均衡考量在犯罪经济学分析中的重要性。本文为构建一个可操作的犯罪模型提供了方法论基础，该模型能够在评估不同政策方案的权衡时，整合多元实证证据与均衡分析视角。
journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
title: Socially Optimal Crime and Punishment
title_zh: 社会最优的犯罪与惩罚

abstract: We present a theory of choice in which attention to the features of options is determined by the decision maker’s categorization of the current problem in a set of problems she solved in the past. Categorization depends on goal-relevant and contextual problem-level features. The model yields heterogeneity in attention and choice in a given problem based on different past experiences and instability when changes in irrelevant context cause re-categorization. We show that heterogeneous and unstable representations of a choice problem unify major biases in judgment and decision making.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一种选择理论，其中决策者对选项特征的关注取决于其将当前问题归类于过去解决过的一组问题中的方式。分类过程依赖于与目标相关的问题层面特征及情境特征。该模型表明，在给定问题中，基于不同的过往经历会产生注意力与选择的异质性；而当无关情境的变化引发重新分类时，则会导致不稳定性。我们证明，选择问题表征的异质性与不稳定性统一了判断与决策中的主要偏差。
title: A Cognitive Theory of Reasoning and Choice
title_zh: 推理与选择的认知理论

abstract: How do regional productivity shocks or transportation infrastructure improvements affect aggregate welfare? In a general class of spatial equilibrium models, we provide a formula for aggregate welfare changes, decomposed into terms associated with (i) technology [Fogel (1964), Railroads and American Economic Growth (Baltimore: Johns Hopkins Press), Hulten (1978) “Growth Accounting with Intermediate Inputs”, The Review of Economic Studies, 45, 511–518], (ii) spatial dispersion of marginal utility, (iii) fiscal externalities, (iv) technological externalities, and (v) redistribution. We further use this decomposition to derive a general formula for optimal spatial transfers and show that, whenever optimal transfers are in place, the technology term alone captures the aggregate welfare effects of technological shocks. We apply our framework to study welfare gains from improving the US highway network. We find that changes in the spatial dispersion of marginal utility are as important as technological externalities in accounting for the deviations from the Fogel-Hulten benchmark to assess welfare gains.
abstract_zh: 区域生产率冲击或交通基础设施改善如何影响总体福利？在一类通用的空间均衡模型中，我们推导出总体福利变化的分解公式，该公式包含以下组成部分：(i) 技术效应 [Fogel (1964), 《铁路与美国经济增长》(巴尔的摩：约翰·霍普金斯出版社)；Hulten (1978)《中间投入的增长核算》，《经济研究评论》，第45卷，511–518页]；(ii) 边际效用的空间分散程度；(iii) 财政外部性；(iv) 技术外部性；以及(v) 再分配效应。我们进一步利用该分解推导出最优空间转移支付的一般公式，并证明当最优转移支付机制存在时，仅技术效应项即可完全捕捉技术冲击对总体福利的影响。我们将该分析框架应用于评估美国高速公路网络改善带来的福利收益，发现边际效用空间分散程度的变化与技术外部性在解释福利收益偏离Fogel-Hulten基准时具有同等重要性。
title: Unpacking Aggregate Welfare in a Spatial Economy
title_zh: 空间经济中的总福利解构
